The Rule of 72

The trick that does money math in 2 seconds

Bankers and PE investors use it every day. Try the question first.

Quick question

You invest $1,000 at 8% a year. About how long until it doubles?

A6 years
B9 years
C12 years
D15 years

Pick one, then swipe.

Answer
B9 years
72 ÷ 8

= 9 years. Divide 72 by the yearly return. That's roughly how many years it takes to double.
